title: best to the luck
description: you try to survive on a bedrock plane (a port from curseforge may update rarely due to my lazyness)
body:
you survive on a bedrock superflat with NO BONUS CHEST and NO STRUCTURES

due to how much stuff i got in this mod and dont want to fill a whole thing about it i will just say how to survive a little bit so first you spawn in with a sharp stick, use shrap stick on bedrock to get pebbles to make gravel mine gravel to get flint craft a flint knife and make unlit campfire and stone and flint to make a campfire (might take a few trys if unlucky) then kill skeletons, stone robots, and a few zombies turn rotten flesh into leather by cooking it over the campfire use bones to craft sharp bone to get branches turn the branches into branch blocks for leaves after getting anough leaves you can get a leaf block combind it with branch to get 4 saplings plant the saplings on poop block which you get by using player dangerous knife on your self and eatting the strange meat after that mine the grown tree turn it into planks (planning to change it once crude iron is added) turn it into a crafting table and boom you got a crafting table

curse forge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/best-of-luck-possible-bedrock-superflat
